---
description: A stable baseline anchor for the process-lint fixture corpus.
---

This file exists so the hostile corpus has something to pin that **cannot move underneath
it**. Every fixture's `baseline:` block used to point at `.claude/commands/arc-commit.md`
and carry that file's real sha256 — which meant the corpus asserted a *snapshot of repo
state* rather than a *rule*. The moment Phase 01's flip added a DO-NOT-EDIT header to the
three pilot commands, all 82 fixtures went red at once, none of them for the reason they
were written to test.

That is the shape retro-log 2026-08-02 records: a test over live repo state has to assert
the rule and branch on the state, never one snapshot value, or the suite measures the
calendar and its red tells you nothing.

Do not edit this file. Its bytes are pinned by every fixture's `baseline.sha256`; changing
them re-reds the whole corpus for no reason, which is the exact failure it was created to
end.
